27fd31cb0c6b0ec3fe3f4c80bf5fc28a8f400a8e.caption: STIHL Service Communication support news page in desktop (stacked=false) and mobile (stacked=true) layouts, showing a grid of news cards. Below the cards, the desktop layout has "32 — 40 of 56 items" followed by pagination controls "1" to "7" with page 4 active, and the mobile layout shows the same item range above pagination "1", "2", "3" (active), "...", "7".

396eae45b9009d9d593fee1aa60d772108a10937.caption: Anatomy of Page Navigation shown twice with 9 page items and page 7 active: in the top row callout 1 points at the previous link, callout 2 at the next link and callout 3 at the group of page numbers with ellipsis; in the bottom row callout 4 points at the first page link (1), callout 5 at the last page link (50), callout 6 at a page number item (5), callout 7 at the current page (7, underlined in orange), callout 8 at an ellipsis and callout 9 at a divider between items.

3aa383615820da51c0541260e153b86a32160ac6.caption: Two pagination bars with page items "1", "...", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9", "...", "50" and dark previous and next arrow buttons, linked by a purple arrow from top to bottom. In the top bar page 7 is the active page (bold, orange underline) and page 8 is focused with a dark outline; in the bottom bar page 8 is now active and keeps the focus outline, so focus stays on the triggered control after the page change.

3d3cf4aa6fead71801e704303522071425759c7b.caption: Do example: two schematic page wireframes side by side, each with an image area, a text bar and a pagination bar at the bottom, linked by a purple arrow. The active page changes from the second to the fifth item while both pages show the same scroll position (the dashed purple viewport frames are aligned), so the user's scroll position is kept when switching pages.

57b89c74804ea53121ce1c0a4d3e3d941ffd82a4.caption: Two schematic pages with STIHL header and a grey content block. Callout 1: pagination placed right-aligned below the content it controls. Callout 2: an additional pagination placed above a tall content block (for tables or large datasets) in addition to the mandatory one below it.

Callout 1 (default): Page Navigation + Pagination Controls, the stacked variant of it, and Page Navigation alone are all right-aligned to the content edge, marked by a dotted line. cb93e244b74651ac8273ef9c54ff7f9951a17994.caption: Don't example: two schematic page wireframes linked by a purple arrow. Right: page number item in enabled and active states (default, hover / pressed, focus), the page navigation items ellipsis and divider element, and the optional pagination controls with "Items per page:" select (values 10, 25, 50, 100) and the range text "10 — 50 of 1000 items".
